title: ResumeRequest
description: Body for ResumeRun after LangGraph interrupt(). Maps exclusively to Command(resume=...). Same thread_id as the interrupted run. Do not include original graph input. Do not set checkpoint_id unless intentionally time-traveling.

graph_id.description: Same assistant/graph as the interrupted run

resume.description: Single resume value OR map of interrupt_id → value for parallel interrupts. Becomes return value(s) of interrupt() in the node.

approval_id.description: Optional link to already-recorded Approval when governance gated the resume
